summary: RDL Accountants is a Chartered Accounting firm in Blackburn, Melbourne, with 60+ years of history, tax as its major activity, and audit, business services and not-for-profit work. Matthew Hung, Director since 2013, spoke in a 2025 Bigfish case study about being the first call for clients and being selective about AI features. The firm was advertising for tax and business services intermediates, seniors and graduates in November 2026.

first.subject: A focused AI use at RDL
first.body:
Hi Matthew,

In the Bigfish case study you said every platform seems to have a new AI feature, but you don't want 100 features you don't use. That is how I built Vert: one job, reconciliation and cash coding, turned from hours into minutes, with a traceable audit trail instead of guessing. RDL advertising for tax and business services intermediates and seniors this month suggests the team is busy, and that capacity is better spent on advice than matching transactions. Is reconciliation somewhere RDL would consider AI?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech
